From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Public school in Lakeland, Polk County, Florida, United States Kathleen Senior High School Location 1100 Red Devil Way Lakeland , Polk County , Florida 33805 United States Coordinates 28°3′24.6″N 81°59′43.6″W ﻿ / ﻿ 28.056833°N 81.995444°W ﻿ / 28.056833; -81.995444 Information School type Public school Motto "Go Big Red" Established 1928 School district Polk County Public Schools Principal Daraford Jones Teaching staff 76.00 (FTE) [ 1 ] Enrollment 1,861 [ 1 ] (2024-2025) Student to teacher ratio 24.49 [ 1 ] Colors Red, white and black Mascot Red Devil Accreditations Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Website https://khs.polkschoolsfl.com/ Kathleen Senior High School is the second oldest of four high schools in Lakeland , Florida , United States .
